en: A black-and-white (sepia-toned) postcard image showing a central European town square, with prominent older buildings around the edges, two tall industrial chimneys in the background, a fountain or monument in the center, and ornate street lamps. The text "Frohburg i. S. Markt." appears at the top, suggesting the market square of Frohburg is depicted. There are also commercial signs visible on some of the buildings.
